gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis: Patients must have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma.
High Grade Glioma; Replication Repair Deficient

candidate_evidence.quote: This is open label, multicentre, single arm, pilot study of upfront nivolumab in patients with RRD-glioblastoma with favorable immune/genomic biomarkers.
All patients will be administered Nivolumab with or without radiation

candidate_flag.reason: Both registered arms are typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR (no EXPERIMENTAL arm), although nivolumab is the investigational agent of this single-arm pilot; rule 1 (comparator arm only) vs rule 4 could change candidate status.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Prior Therapy: No prior therapy except surgery will be permitted for high grade glioma.
The purpose of the study is to use upfront immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) to delay/avoid radiation for patients with RRD-glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: This is open label, multicentre, single arm, pilot study of upfront nivolumab in patients with RRD-glioblastoma with favorable immune/genomic biomarkers.

flag.reason: Only arms are typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR; coded as candidate because nivolumab is the investigational agent of the single-arm pilot.

source_quote.quote: Proof of RRD: By tumor immunohistochemistry showing functional loss of mismatch repair gene expression (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2), or based on prior germline testing confirming congenital mismatch repair deficiency (CMMRD) or Lynch syndrome.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: PD1 and CD8 positivity (favorable immune markers)

source_quote.quote: Favorable immune markers: High PD1 and CD8 positivity as detailed in the lab manual.

flag.reason: PD1/CD8 immune-infiltrate positivity is an entry requirement; judged mechanistically linked to the anti-PD-1 candidate, but it is an immune-contexture marker rather than a classic genomic target.

source_quote.quote: Provide a tumor tissue specimen for molecular profiling, including TMB analysis.

coder_notes: Phase NA, ages 12 months to 25 years (CHILD+ADULT). Population: conditions say high-grade glioma but inclusion requires histologically confirmed glioblastoma -> gbm_only. Nivolumab is the only drug; both arms (domains) are typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR though the study is a single-arm pilot of upfront nivolumab, so coded experimental_monotherapy with uncertain flag. Regimen: Domain 1 is nivolumab alone (no RT) and Domain 2 adds radiation; coded combination because radiotherapy is given in a treatment arm - adjudicator may prefer monotherapy (primary question is upfront ICI alone). MMR deficiency may be established by germline testing (CMMRD/Lynch) as an alternative to tumour IHC; recorded as tumour RRD eligibility biomarker matched to nivolumab. TMB analysis is a tissue-submission requirement, coded exploratory_correlative. The summary mentions studying tumour evolution in response to ICI using tissue at progression, but no specific pharmacodynamic endpoint is registered -> target_engagement no.
